constraints.ocl:
context Patient
inv: self.isInsured implies self.insurance <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (self.departments->size() = 3)

context Hospital
inv: self.wards->any(x | x.floor >= 5) <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.wards->collect(x | x.name)->notEmpty()) and (self.address <> '' and self.address.size() > 0)

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 6 and self.totalAmount <= 65

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 4 and self.totalAmount <= 6

context Department
inv: self.nurses->size() >= 2 and self.nurses->size() <= 3

context Ward
inv: self.floor >= 32 and self.floor <= 89

context Ward
inv: (self.name <> null) and (self.rooms->any(x | x.roomNo <> '') <> null)

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->exists(x | x.name <> '')) and (not(self.departments->exists(x | x.name <> '')))

context Bed
inv: ((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.bedNo.size() <= 22)) and (not((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.bedNo.size() <= 22)))

context Hospital
inv: (self.wards->forAll(x | x.floor < 50)) and (self.wards->exists(x | not(x.floor < 50)))

context Department
inv: (self.doctors->forAll(x | x.specialty <> '')) and (self.doctors->exists(x | not(x.specialty <> '')))

context Room
inv: ((self.roomNo <> '') and (self.beds->forAll(v | v.isOccupied <> true))) and (self.beds->exists(v | not(v.isOccupied <> true)))

metadata.contradiction_ocl:
context Room
inv: self.beds->exists(v | not(v.isOccupied <> true))

constraints.ocl:
context Department
inv: ((self.nurses->any(x | x.nurseId <> '') <> null) and (self.nurses->exists(x | x.shift <> ''))) and (not((self.nurses->any(x | x.nurseId <> '') <> null) and (self.nurses->exists(x | x.shift <> ''))))

context Admission
inv: (self.discharge <> null) and (not(self.discharge <> null))

context Department
inv: (self.nurses->exists(x | x.nurseId <> '')) and (not(self.nurses->exists(x | x.nurseId <> '')))
